notes: No regions. The profits tax return date depends on the financial year end (the IRD's accounting-date codes).

items.name: Business Registration Certificate Renewal
items.rule: Before the certificate expires (every 1 or 3 years, on the anniversary of commencement)
items.applies: Every business carried on in Hong Kong
items.description: The renewal demand is issued about a month before expiry; the fee includes the levy.
items.authority: Business Registration Office, Inland Revenue Department

items.name: Annual Return (Form NAR1)
items.rule: Within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation
items.description: Late delivery attracts escalating registration fees and possible prosecution.

items.name: Annual Return of a Registered Non-Hong Kong Company (Form NN3) with Accounts
items.rule: Within 42 days after the anniversary of registration in Hong Kong
items.description: Delivered with the company's latest published accounts where its home law requires them.

items.name: Annual General Meeting and Audited Financial Statements
items.rule: Within 9 months after financial year end
items.applies: Private companies (unless the AGM is dispensed with by unanimous resolution)
items.description: Audited financial statements are laid before the members.

items.name: Significant Controllers Register
items.rule: Keep current; enter changes within 7 days of confirming them
items.description: Kept at the registered office and open to law enforcement officers.

items.name: Profits Tax Return (BIR51 / BIR52)
items.rule: Mid-August under the block extension scheme for tax representatives (otherwise 1 month from issue)
items.applies: Businesses with a December year end ("D" code)
items.description: Issued on the first working day of April; filed with audited financial statements and a tax computation (partnerships file BIR52).

items.name: Profits Tax Return (BIR51 / BIR52)
items.rule: Mid-November under the block extension scheme for tax representatives (otherwise 1 month from issue)
items.applies: Businesses with a year end between 1 January and 31 March ("M" code)
items.description: Issued on the first working day of April; filed with audited financial statements and a tax computation (partnerships file BIR52).

items.name: Profits Tax Return (BIR51 / BIR52)
items.rule: Around the end of May under the block extension scheme (otherwise 1 month from issue)
items.applies: Businesses with a year end between 1 April and 30 November ("N" code)
items.description: Issued on the first working day of April; filed with audited financial statements and a tax computation (partnerships file BIR52).

items.name: Profits Tax — Final and Provisional Tax Payments
items.rule: On the two dates in the notice of assessment (usually between November and April)
items.description: Provisional tax for the next year is charged with the final tax for the year assessed.

items.name: Individual Tax Return (BIR60)
items.rule: Within 3 months of issue for sole proprietors (issued in early May)
items.description: A sole proprietor reports the business's profits in the individual return.

items.name: Employer's Return (BIR56A and IR56B)
items.rule: Within 1 month of issue (issued on the first working day of April)
items.description: Reports each employee's income for the year ended 31 March.

items.name: Employee Start and Leaving Notifications (IR56E, IR56F, IR56G)
items.rule: IR56E within 3 months of hiring; IR56F 1 month before employment ends; IR56G 1 month before an employee leaves Hong Kong
items.description: Money due to an employee leaving Hong Kong is withheld until the IRD issues a letter of release.

items.name: MPF Contributions
items.description: Employer and employee mandatory contributions are paid to the MPF trustee with a remittance statement; new employees are enrolled within 60 days.

items.name: Employees' Compensation Insurance Renewal
items.rule: Before the policy expires each year
items.description: Cover is compulsory for all employees; the notice of insurance is displayed at the workplace.

items.name: Transfer Pricing Master File and Local File
items.rule: Within 9 months after financial year end
items.applies: Businesses with related-party transactions that exceed the size and transaction thresholds
items.description: Country-by-country notifications are due within 3 months after the group's year end.
